digest.component_or_area: transition close command and signing pipeline
propositions: rebar transition close commits the status event and releases the lock before the completion signature append, allowing a 60s write_lock timeout in the signing tail to raise SigningError after the close has landed durably

the close_ticket handler catches SigningError and writes a bare lock error message to stderr with exit code 0, falling through to return the normal success payload which carries no field indicating the signature outcome, making the loss undetectable to callers

callers cannot distinguish a successful signed close from a closed-without-signature close because close_ticket returns no machine-readable marker of the signature outcome, only an English warning to stderr that misreports the failed signature as a failed close

the completion_signature field with closed-vocabulary cause values (signed, sign_failed, material_drifted, force_bypassed) must be added to the return payload and threaded through all three public surfaces (library, CLI JSON output, MCP) so callers can programmatically branch on signature success without parsing English
the stderr message must honestly state that the close landed and only the signature failed, not present the lock timeout as a close failure, and must tell the reader not to re-run the transition

idea-to-closed transitions must not carry a completion_signature field because a REJECT/DROP of an undesigned idea is not a completion event and inventing a cause would misreport a deliberate non-event
